bio.text: Chris Pringle, a Republican, has represented District 101 in the Alabama House of Representatives since November 5, 2014, and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot for re-election.
He was elected House Speaker Pro Tempore on January 10, 2023.
Pringle received a B.A. in communications from the University of Alabama, and his professional experience includes working as a realtor and a general contractor.
